about_pullquote: Good paintwork speaks for itself—and lasts for years if done right.
about_para_1: DK Pro Painting Contractors was founded on a simple principle: a fresh coat of paint shouldn't mean weeks of disruption or shoddy preparation. For over 15 years, we've built our reputation in Sheffield and South Yorkshire by showing up on time, finishing what we start, and leaving every job spotless. Our team includes time-served decorators who've worked on new builds, listed properties, and family homes alike.
about_para_2: Customers return to us because we listen first, quote fairly, and never cut corners on prep work—the foundation of any lasting finish. We've earned trust by being honest about timescales, communicating openly, and standing behind every project. Whether it's a single bedroom refresh or a multi-storey commercial repaint, we bring the same attention to detail.

reviews.text: Brilliant job on our lounge. Came in, got on with it, and left the place immaculate. Dave and his team were polite, professional, and finished bang on schedule. Couldn't fault them. Already planning to have them back for the rest of the house.
reviews.author: Mark T.

reviews.text: Had the exterior painted before winter set in. They prep properly—that makes all the difference. Nine months on and it still looks fresh. Fair price, no messing about. Highly recommend.
reviews.author: Caroline K.

reviews.text: We run a small retail unit and needed a quick turnaround. DK Pro fitted us in after hours, did a quality job, and were in and out as promised. Made my life easier. Genuine tradespeople—not cowboys.
reviews.author: Ravi P.
